key_highlights: ASX 200 extends weekly winning streak to three, underpinned by rallies in resources and technology sectors.
Spike in NSW unemployment to a five-year high cools RBA rate hike expectations while putting downward pressure on the AUD.
Domestic housing distress mounts with Sydney auction clearance rates tumbling into crash territory.
Global trade risks escalate around China Shock 2.0 export spillovers and industrial headwinds.

sectors.trend: Resource equities supported broad index gains alongside strong exploration and fast-tracked gold and rare earths development.
sectors.implications: Supportive environment for mid-tier producers, though iron ore remains exposed to Chinese economic shifts.

sectors.trend: Rising unemployment and housing auction clearance slumps dampen credit expansion and raise mortgage stress concerns.
sectors.implications: Net interest margins face compression if RBA pauses, while credit impairment risks rise for major domestic lenders.

sectors.trend: Tech shares surged alongside mining stocks, driving broader equity market outperformance.
sectors.implications: Valuation multiples benefit from easing rate hike expectations, though sustainable earnings delivery remains crucial.

sectors.trend: Domestic gas market faces supply constraints, regulatory friction, and decommissioning scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Elevated domestic energy input costs and heightened operational and compliance risks for east coast gas operators.

sectors.trend: Sharp cooling in auction markets and residential stress contrast with stabilized borrowing cost expectations.
sectors.implications: Residential developers face margin compression; prime industrial and commercial REITs remain relatively insulated.

key_themes: Divergence between resilient equity market momentum and deteriorating real economy indicators.
RBA tightening cycle paused by softening labor market conditions and weak housing dynamics.
Commodity and critical mineral fast-tracking amid global supply security priorities.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Domestic Labor Market Weakness & Economic Slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shift equity allocations towards non-cyclical, export-oriented earners with foreign currency revenues.
Underweight pure-play residential developers and banks with concentrated high-LVR mortgage books.
Hedge commodity cyclicality through precious metals and diversified global blue-chips.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: East Coast Domestic Gas & Energy Bottlenecks
risk_assessment.mitigation: Focus on upstream producers with secured long-term contracts and low decommissioning liabilities.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold and Precious Metal Producers
opportunities.rationale: Fast-tracked output and safe-haven demand provide defensive cash flow amid currency volatility and geopolitical friction.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective Exposure to ASX Technology Leaders
opportunities.rationale: Relief from prospective RBA rate hikes supports valuation multiples of structural growth software and tech stocks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Overweight Positions in Domestic Retail Banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Spike in unemployment and housing distress threaten asset quality and credit growth.
Disconnect between index gains and macro deterioration increases risk of sharp pullbacks.

market_outlook.short_term: Rangebound ASX 200 with resource strength offsetting pressure on bank and retail sectors following soft jobs data.
market_outlook.long_term: Selective upside for global resources and defensive growth; domestic cyclical sectors remain challenged by consumer and housing headwinds.
key_catalysts: Upcoming RBA Board meeting and monetary policy statement.
Australian quarterly CPI release and national unemployment trajectory.
China economic policy responses and trade tariff developments.
East coast domestic gas regulatory updates.
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate movements around key support levels.
Sydney and Melbourne property auction clearance rates and listing volumes.
Iron ore 62% Fe CFR and gold spot price benchmarks.
ASX 200 bank index vs resource index relative performance.
